text:
alex: Quick report from the embed/rerank onboarding run: Node helper + SDK auto-retry produced mismatched vector dims and wrong mapping back to queries.

priya: Oof. Minimal repro?

alex: Sampleapp sends var-length vectors (some padded, some trimmed) to the embeddings endpoint via the batch helper. When a retry occurs the patched payload occasionally has a different vector length order and the response parsing assumes positional alignment. Example outgoing snippet we logged: 
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "c1", "vector": [0.2,0.3,0.5]},
    {"id": "c2", "vector": [0.1,0.2]},
    {"id": "c3", "vector": [0.9,0.0,0.1]}
  ]
}
```
On a retry you might see the assembled dispatch as c2,c1,c3 which leaves the consumer code matching embeddings by index and yielding wrong dim length assumptions and downstream cosine errors.

matt: Are the SDKs normalizing vector lengths before sending? That's a bug in the helper: it should enforce a canonical shape or include an explicit id->index map in the payload.

alex: Node helper was compressing small vectors into Float32Array buffers for performance; the buffer concat step didn't preserve item boundaries when retries re-merged chunks. Python helper used a list-of-lists and saw it less.

priya: Short-term mitigation: on the client side, use stable ids (you have id) and make post-response mapping by id. Also validate vector length per item before sending and reject mixed lengths (or explicitly pad).

matt: Filed ticket DE-8021 to change the helper behavior: 1) always attach "_seq" monotonic per item, 2) include explicit id map in batch metadata, 3) canonicalize vectors to a declared dim or send dim in per-item metadata. Assigned to eng-ml.

alex: I'll open a PR to update the sampleapp: add a validation step + example mapping-by-id after receiving embeddings, and a note in onboarding doc advising to never assume index alignment when using retries.

devex-bot: DE-8021 created and linked to #eng-ml.

priya: Also noticed auth retry interplay: when the token refresh triggers mid-batch we sometimes end up re-sending a partial batch + fresh batch that the helper concatenates naively. Suggest the helper pause batching during token refresh and rehydrate items with seq ids.

matt: Good call. Add an integration test that simulates token expiry mid-batch, server 502 and then success, with randomized reorder. We'll add that to CI flakiness suite.

alex: For anyone blocked: quick fix in sampleapp is four lines: (1) validate dims; (2) add id per item; (3) map results by id; (4) log if dim != expected. I'll push the PR with test vectors.

priya: Thanks. Can we get a patch release for Node helper this week? Customers hitting onboarding will trip this.

matt: Yep planning a 0.12.3 patch cut after DE-8021 review.

alex: Resolving this thread for now; follow DE-8021 for the helper fix and the sampleapp PR for the short-term docs/patch.
